title: Satellite tuning file
description: The file game/tuning/drifters/satellite.json. The same fields as drifter-tuning.schema.json, and each variant also sets angle_degrees and has exactly two boxes: the body first, then the panel bar. Values from drifters/02-satellite.md (guess): variants flat (default, angle 0) and angled (angle 20), each 36 wide and 12 tall, body box 12 x 12 and panel bar box 36 x 6, both centered; speed_ratio 0.375; entry_warning_ticks 60 (07-drifters.md, shared). Key mapping to the GDD: angle_degrees is the variant's angle below level in 02-satellite.md, variants. Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Tuning loader), which builds core.drifters.satellite.SatelliteVariantExtra from angle_degrees. The loader also enforces the two rules drifter-tuning.schema.json names: default_variant is one of the variant names, and every box lies inside its variant's width x height footprint. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md, Rules, Satellite.

default_variant.description: The variant a placement gets when it names none (07-drifters.md, rule 10). Must be a key of variants.

variants.description: Named variants (07-drifters.md, rule 10). A new angle or size is a new entry here and needs no code (02-satellite.md, How to extend).

angle_degrees.description: Path angle below level, degrees. 0 flies level; 20 sinks 20 degrees as it crosses. Never scaled by level (02-satellite.md, rule 6).

hitbox.description: Exactly two boxes, offsets from the satellite's center: the body first, then the panel bar. The view draws them in that order of meaning: body white on top of the blue bar (02-satellite.md, hitbox, placeholder_look). Never bigger than the look.
